subject.title: [Feature]: Overview should show config file path

question: Should OpenClaw accept a prominent Control UI Overview row for the existing admin-scoped configPath snapshot field, or rely on existing CLI/config surfaces?
rationale: The technical fix is small and source-backed, but the issue asks for prominent placement and the linked PR is blocked on proof and final UX acceptance rather than a missing gateway API.

options.title: Accept the Overview row
options.body: Land the linked presentation-only PR after real Control UI proof and locale alignment confirm the active config path is visible.

options.title: Move it to Settings
options.body: Ask for the same existing snapshot/config path to be surfaced in a more explicit Settings or Config information row instead of the Overview card.

options.title: Keep CLI only
options.body: Close the request as covered by `openclaw config file` if maintainers do not want another UI exposure point for local paths.

recommendation.title: Accept the Overview row
recommendation.body: Land the linked presentation-only PR after real Control UI proof and locale alignment confirm the active config path is visible.

likelyOwner.reason: BunsDev has the strongest feature-history signal for the Overview UI structure that would receive this row.
